name: shadow-sparta-intent
description: SPARTA query intent and bridge tag extraction

cases.input: What cryptographic controls should be applied to spacecraft uplink commands to prevent replay attacks from compromised ground stations?
How can anomaly detection in spacecraft telemetry streams identify T1499 denial-of-service flooding attempts against the command processor?
What network segmentation strategies prevent lateral movement from a compromised payload instrument to the spacecraft bus and attitude control system?
What vulnerabilities in the CCSDS telecommand frame authentication protocol could an adversary exploit to inject unauthorized commands into a spacecraft uplink session?
What procedures enable recovery of spacecraft flight software to a known-good state after a SEU-induced memory corruption event corrupts the primary boot partition?
